_why: 13 Nov 2026: Franklin chose Qwen3-TTS for Tech Education and asked to hear a female version. Three female designs, Qwen3 only, named samples at their own speed.
voice_design: A calm, deep male narrator in his thirties, clear neutral American accent, confident and friendly, measured explainer pace, like a good tech teacher.

qwen3_designs.qwen3_female_1_warm_teacher: A calm, warm female narrator in her early thirties, clear neutral American accent, confident and friendly, measured explainer pace, like a good tech teacher.
qwen3_designs.qwen3_female_2_bright_storyteller: A bright, engaging young woman in her late twenties, clear American accent, curious and upbeat but never rushed, a storyteller explaining technology to a friend.
qwen3_designs.qwen3_female_3_documentary: A composed, lower-pitched female voice in her early forties, clear neutral accent, authoritative and reassuring, like a documentary narrator explaining how software works.
